notes:
Ostraca 0.7.26 for Windows x64 and Android ARM64

- One sign-in starts private, automatic account sync for eligible notes, transcripts and recordings while the app is open. On upgrade from an earlier saved session, sign in once in Settings → Connect. There are no publish or pairing buttons.
- Open read-only libraries from the other device in Settings → Library. Account Transcripts supports edits and on-demand original audio. Choose On this device for the unchanged local originals.
- Fixed Android ARM64 private library access. Existing legacy/shared bindings stay in place; attachments and recordings above 64 MiB are not synced. Android installation still requires the system confirmation. No Linux update.
